sources.note: Nothing. Classified Unclassifiable; zero descriptive references; sole reference is Ethnologue (Eberhard, Simons & Fennig 2025) giving status 'second language only' / extinct; alt names Langaj, Langay.

Nothing. Describes Langaj as a specialized ritual vocabulary (words, songs, incantations, some secret, from various African languages) used in Vodou ceremonies, not a full language; no native speakers; sole reference Ethnologue 18th ed. (2015).
